settings_library_categorization_descript: Champions, maps and tags get read from each mod's files.
settings_library_categorization_hint: They are offered as suggested categories and as library filters. Turn this off to rely only on the categories you set yourself.
settings_library_promotion_description: Enabled mods move to the front of their folder in Priority sorting.
settings_library_storage_description: Leave empty for the app data directory.
settings_library_trusted_domains_descrip: One-click links only install from these domains. Remove all of them to allow any source.
settings_library_watcher_description: Mods added or removed outside the app show up in the library.
settings_library_watcher_hint: Filesystem notifications vary across platforms and antivirus software, so watching can miss an update or fire falsely. Requires a restart to take effect.
